 Open Navigation Menu Menu Search Search News Hayley Williams-Curated Outbreak Fest Features Dinosaur Jr., Blood Orange
 Also: Mannequin Pussy, Rico Nasty, Ear, Soul Glo, and, yes, Hayley Williams By Alex Suskind November 16, 2026 Getty Images Comment Loader Save Story Save this story Comment Loader Save Story Save this story Hayley Williams is adding festival curator to her C.V. The Paramore singer, who is currently on tour in South America , was asked to choose the lineup for next year’s Outbreak Fest in Manchester. Among her selections: Dinosaur Jr. , Blood Orange, Wednesday, American Football, Julien Baker, Mannequin Pussy, Rico Nasty, Ear, Soul Glo, and Feeble Little Horse. Williams will also headline both nights. You can check out the full poster and lineup below. The two-day event takes place on June 19 and 20 at B.E.C. Arena.
 “Downright blasphemous to let me do this but its gonna be a good time and fucking rival schools,” Williams wrote on Instagram about curating the 15-year-old hardcore and punk event, which has recently expanded to other genres. A portion of proceeds from each ticket to the 2027 edition will be donated to Medical Aid For Palestinians ,  Not A Phase , and Manchester Central Foodbank .
 In addition to the tour (her second of the year ), Williams has spent 2026 debuting a new side project, Powersnatch . She was also, mere hours before the Outbreak announcement, nominated for a Best Alternative Music Performance Grammy for “Showbiz,” off 2025’s Ego Death at a Bachelorette Party .
